title: FMD Day 1: Transition (1,100 kcal)
ingredients:
30g rolled oats
25g walnuts
40g strawberries
150ml unsweetened almond milk
200g carrots
10g fresh ginger
15ml olive oil (for soup)
water
salt
25g macadamia nuts
10 green olives
40g dry quinoa
75g arugula
15ml olive oil (for bowl)
15g pine nuts
instructions:
BREAKFAST
Combine the rolled oats, walnuts, and strawberries in a bowl, then pour the unsweetened almond milk over them.

LUNCH
1. Boil the carrots (200g) and ginger (10g) in water with a pinch of salt until soft.
2. Blend them until smooth.
3. Stir in the measured olive oil (15ml) OFF the heat to preserve delicate fats.

SNACK
Enjoy the macadamia nuts alongside the green olives.

DINNER
1. Weigh your quinoa (40g) dry before boiling it in water.
2. Toss the cooked quinoa, arugula, pine nuts, and olive oil in a bowl.

title: FMD Day 2: Autophagy Focus (800 kcal)
ingredients:
20g chia seeds
150ml almond milk
30g blueberries
150g carrots
10ml extra virgin olive oil (for soup)
water
salt
20g pumpkin seeds
100g kale
15ml olive oil (for salad)
20g pecans
20g dry quinoa
instructions:
BREAKFAST
Mix the chia seeds and almond milk, let sit in the fridge overnight to thicken, then top with blueberries.

LUNCH
1. Boil carrots in water with a pinch of salt until tender.
2. Blend until smooth.
3. Remove from heat and stir in the extra virgin olive oil.

SNACK
Enjoy the pumpkin seeds raw or lightly dry-toasted.

DINNER
1. Cook your quinoa (20g) dry.
2. Massage the kale with olive oil to soften it.
3. Toss the massaged kale, quinoa, and pecans in a salad bowl.

title: FMD Day 3: Cellular Clean-up (800 kcal)
ingredients:
20g rolled oats
10g hemp hearts
50g strawberries
water (for porridge)
75g green beans
100g carrots
10ml olive oil (for toss)
10g sliced almonds
12 green olives
30g dry quinoa
100g cucumber
15ml olive oil (for bowl)
15g walnuts
instructions:
BREAKFAST
Simmer rolled oats and hemp hearts in water until soft, then top with fresh strawberries.

LUNCH
1. Steam the green beans and carrots.
2. Toss with olive oil off the heat.
3. Garnish with sliced almonds.

SNACK
Enjoy the green olives.

DINNER
1. Boil the quinoa dry.
2. Chop the cucumber.
3. Toss quinoa, cucumber, walnuts, and olive oil in a bowl.

title: FMD Day 4: Deep Fasting (800 kcal)
ingredients:
20g macadamia nuts
40g strawberries
10g chia seeds
100ml almond milk
75g baby spinach
100g carrots
10ml olive oil (for soup)
pinch of turmeric
water
salt
15g pecans
100g arugula
10ml olive oil (for salad)
20g pine nuts
10g hemp hearts
instructions:
BREAKFAST
Combine almond milk and chia seeds, top with macadamia nuts and strawberries.

LUNCH
1. Boil carrots in water with a pinch of salt and turmeric until soft.
2. Stir in baby spinach until wilted.
3. Blend until smooth, then stir in olive oil off the heat.

SNACK
Enjoy the pecans.

DINNER
Toss arugula, pine nuts, hemp hearts, and olive oil together.

title: FMD Day 5: Final Cycle (800 kcal)
ingredients:
20g oats
15g walnuts
30g blueberries
water (for oatmeal)
100g cucumber
50g carrots
10ml olive oil (for salad)
10g hemp hearts
10 black olives
200g carrots
15ml olive oil (for mash)
15g pumpkin seeds
20g dry quinoa
water
salt
instructions:
BREAKFAST
Cook oats in water, top with walnuts and blueberries.

LUNCH
Dice cucumber and carrots, toss with hemp hearts and olive oil.

SNACK
Enjoy the black olives.

DINNER
1. Boil carrots until soft, mash with olive oil.
2. Boil quinoa separately.
3. Mix mash and quinoa together, garnish with pumpkin seeds.

title: FMD Day 6: Autophagy Support (800 kcal)
ingredients:
15g chia seeds
150ml unsweetened coconut milk
40g raspberries
150g zucchini
50g celery
10ml olive oil (for soup)
water
salt
15g almonds
5 green olives
80g avocado
100g baby spinach
15ml olive oil (for salad)
15g pumpkin seeds
instructions:
BREAKFAST
Whisk chia seeds and coconut milk, let set, top with fresh raspberries.

LUNCH
1. Boil diced zucchini and celery in water with a pinch of salt until soft.
2. Blend until smooth, then stir in olive oil off the heat.

SNACK
Enjoy raw almonds alongside green olives.

DINNER
1. Slice the avocado and rinse baby spinach.
2. Toss avocado, spinach, and pumpkin seeds with olive oil.

title: FMD Day 7: Cellular Refresh (800 kcal)
ingredients:
15g ground flaxseeds
10g walnuts (for porridge)
100ml almond milk
water
150g cucumber
100g cherry tomatoes
10ml olive oil (for salad)
fresh basil
salt
15g walnuts (for snack)
30g dry quinoa
100g bell peppers
15ml olive oil (for bowl)
10g pine nuts
instructions:
BREAKFAST
Stir ground flaxseeds into simmering almond milk and water to thicken, top with walnuts.

LUNCH
Chop cucumber and tomatoes, toss with fresh basil, olive oil, and a pinch of salt.

SNACK
Enjoy the walnuts.

DINNER
1. Cook quinoa in water.
2. Roast bell peppers until tender.
3. Toss quinoa, roasted peppers, pine nuts, and olive oil in a bowl.
